title: The Ultimate Member – User Profile, Registration, Login, Member Directory, Content Restriction & Membership Plugin…
description: The Ultimate Member WordPress plugin up to version 2.14.0 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'user_url' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected profile pages. Exploitation requires a visitor to click the injected Website URL link, which is enabled by default in new installations.
